decisions.reason: The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already records replacement of the prior FAQ and explicitly includes the prize-claim link change from [URL_002] to [URL_009].
Changing the prize claim page URL does not alter the Big Block prize amounts, draw rules, ticket semantics, funding, or winner-selection method.
Changing the prize claim page URL does not alter the Small Block prize amounts, draw condition, ticket rules, or pool funding.
The prize claim URL is unrelated to the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or wallet delivery of code-based referral commissions.
The prize claim URL does not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The claim page URL change does not alter fiat minting access, dashboard authentication, reward areas, or wallet requirements.
The prize claim URL does not change which book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets transfer with an NFT.
The claim page URL does not alter primary-sale allocations, commission funding, prize-pool funding, or fiat-fee treatment.
The claim page URL does not affect the secondary royalty amount, founder allocation, prize-pool funding, or ticket-generation rules.
The prize claim URL does not alter the trigger, amount, or random-recipient selection for commissions when no referral code is used.
The prize claim URL does not change badge triggers, referral milestone thresholds, or the on-chain badge destination.
Changing a prize claim page URL does not change the required Base blockchain network.
